svg.title: Trajectory Planning Process
svg.desc: Pipeline from perception to motion: perception and mapping provide a costmap; 1. path planning (Hybrid A* with a bicycle model) produces a geometric path of poses; 2. trajectory planning (optimisation for smoothness within velocity and acceleration limits) produces a time-parameterised reference trajectory; 3. a tracking controller (MPC or pure pursuit) sends velocity commands to the vehicle, with state feedback from the vehicle.
